description: Presidential Secretariat - The President has Determined that the Ministerial portfolios Indicated Below Should be in his Charge. 1) Minister of Tourism and Lands, 2) Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs, 3) Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment.
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (the Hon. President) and outlines detailed ministerial portfolios that have been assigned to his charge (Minister of Tourism and Lands, Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs, Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment). This combination of naming a government official and specifying detailed portfolio responsibilities meets the criteria for Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
